verdict.rationale: Bruno is an API client, not an LLM/MCP gateway. However, Ultimate Edition does let License Administrators govern Bruno AI's own LLM traffic: they control which providers and models are allowed and how requests are protected. That is a narrow, product-native form of provider governance and request protection limited to the built-in assistant. Bruno AI is BYOK with no data routed through Bruno servers, so the platform does not proxy traffic. Connecting to company gateways is client-side only and earns no credit. missing for 10: proxying of general LLM/MCP traffic through the platform, token/usage limits, explicit prompt-guard features, provider routing/failover, MCP traffic governance, detailed docs on the governance controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can proxy and govern LLM/MCP traffic (token limits, prompt guards, provider routing) through the platform

citations.quote: License Administrators can govern Bruno AI across the organization, controlling which providers and models are allowed and how requests are protected.
